name: fld_prime_one_mod_three_eq_sq_add_three_sq
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h : p % 3 = 1) : ∃ a b : ℕ, p = a ^ 2 + 3 * b ^ 2
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h : p % 3 = 1), ∃ a b : ℕ, p = a ^ 2 + 3 * b ^ 2
informal: Every prime p ≡ 1 (mod 3) is of the form a^2 + 3b^2 — -3 is a square mod p (cube roots of unity in F_p), so p | x^2 + 3 for some x; Thue's lemma / pigeonhole gives 0 < a^2 + 3b^2 ≡ 0 mod p with a, b < √p, hence a^2 + 3b^2 ∈ {p, 2p, 3p}; 2p is impossible mod 4 (or mod 3) and 3p reduces to p by a = 3a'.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p % 3 = 1 → ∃ a b, p = a ^ 2 + 3 * b ^ 2
